concerns.text: Phase 1.5 tasks (e.g., T016 Core Tabulated Invariant Precision, T017 Hyperbolic Volume Consistency, T014 Persist Raw & Cleaned Data, T018 Contract Test for Data Schema) are scheduled before the data download and parsing tasks (US 1 tasks T011‑T015). They depend on the existence of raw/processed data, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.
T016 explicitly lists a dependency only on T010 (Validation Scope) but also requires the core dataset produced by T011/T012. Scheduling it prior to those tasks creates a hidden dependency violation.
T017 (Hyperbolic Volume Consistency) similarly needs the hyperbolic volume field populated by the download/parsing pipeline, yet it is placed before those producer tasks.
T014 (Persist Raw & Cleaned Data) writes files that are later consumed by many downstream tasks (e.g., regression, plotting). It must occur after the download/parsing steps (US 1).
T018 (Contract Test for Data Schema) validates `data/processed/knots_cleaned.csv`, which does not exist until after US 1 parsing tasks. This test should be scheduled after data generation.
